facts.text: Hank, the serum is wearing off. Eat something. We have a whole war to stop by morning.
facts.why: Invented. A real Xavier line from the opened quote page that suits the film's hope theme: 'Just because someone stumbles and loses their way, it doesn't mean they're lost forever.'
